verses.text:
We give thanks to|strong="H7892"you, God.  
We give thanks, for your Name is near.  
Men tell about your wondrous works.

When I|strong="H8034"choose the|strong="H3034"appointed time,  
I|strong="H8034"will|strong="H8034"judge blamelessly.

The|strong="H3588"earth and|strong="H3947"all|strong="H3947"its|strong="H3588"inhabitants quake.  
I|strong="H3588"firmly hold its|strong="H3588"pillars. Selah.

For|strong="H7311"neither from the|strong="H1696"east, nor from the|strong="H1696"west,  
nor yet|strong="H1696"from the|strong="H1696"south, comes exaltation|strong="H7311".

For|strong="H3588"in|strong="H2088"the|strong="H3588"LORD|strong="H3068"’s hand there|strong="H2088"is|strong="H2088"a|strong="H3068"cup,  
full of|strong="H8199"foaming wine mixed with|strong="H8199"spices.  
He|strong="H3588"pours it|strong="H3588"out.  
Indeed|strong="H3588"the|strong="H3588"wicked of|strong="H8199"the|strong="H3588"earth drink and|strong="H2088"drink it|strong="H3588"to|strong="H3588"its|strong="H3588"very|strong="H2088"dregs.
